token.title: 🔑 GitHub tɔken
token.intro: GitHub ɖoa biabia 60 ŋu le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me na adrɛs si medɔa tɔken o. Fork ƒe ati bliboa xɔa abe 32 ene, eya ta le tsatsa evelia me la, biabiawo vɔna. Tɔken tsɔa seɖoƒe la yia 5000 le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me.
token.step1: Ʋu Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, emegbe Generate new token.
token.step2: Nunɔamesi ƒe tɔ: wò ŋutɔ wò akɔnta. Nuwuwu: ŋkeke ɖesiaɖe, ati la mehiã naneke si anɔ anyi ɣeyiɣi didi o.
token.step4: Megaka asi mɔɖeɖe aɖeke ŋu o. Nudzraɖoƒe si ƒe amewo katã tɔ ƒe metanyatakakawo mehiã wo dometɔ aɖeke o.
token.step5: Wɔe, emegbe kɔpi {token} ƒe asixɔxɔ. GitHub ɖenɛ fiana zi ɖeka ko.
token.classic: Tɔken xoxo hã wɔa dɔ: wɔ ɖeka eye mègatia ŋutete aɖeke o. Ŋutete ƒuƒlu hã xlẽa nyatakaka siwo ƒe amewo katã tɔ le ame si woɖo kpe edzi ƒe duƒuƒu nu.
token.stays: Enɔa brausa sia me le safui {key} te eye eyina {host} ko gbɔ. Womeŋlɔa eŋu ɖe adrɛs ƒe fli me gbeɖe o, eya ta kadodo si nàma la tsɔa kpɔɖeŋu la ɖe asi, ke menye wò kpeɖodzinuwo o. Kpɔtɔ si le teƒe la te gbugbɔa etutuna kple nudzraɖoƒe kpui la.
token.persistHow: Tsɔ tɔken la de sɛva si tsɔ axa sia ƒe agbalẽ {env} me, le {port} ŋu:
token.proxy: eye nàdze egɔme kple {make}. Emegbe agbalẽdzraɖoƒe la ŋlɔa nginx ƒe akpa aɖe si tsɔa tanya {header} kpena ɖe {path} proxy ŋu, eya ta brausa la yɔa eya ŋutɔ ƒe dzɔtsoƒe eye mexɔa tɔken la gbeɖe o. Teƒe sia bu eye amedzro ɖesiaɖe mana 5000 ɖeka le gaƒoƒo ɖeka me.
fork.refused404: Alɔ ƒe fli aɖeke meli o: {message}. 404 le afi sia fia alɔ si meli o alo mɔ si sɛva ƒe proxy metsɔna o; fork ƒe kadodo si le etame la de blibo le go eveawo siaa me.
fork.refusedExhausted: Biabiawo vɔ le GitHub si le gaƒoƒo sia me, eya ta womete ŋu ta alɔ ƒe fli aɖeke o. Fork ƒe kadodo si le etame la de blibo. Tsɔ tɔken kpe ɖe eŋu le tiatia ƒe akpa me, alo tsi alɔ ƒe fliwo le nɔnɔme ƒe akpa me be woazã biabiawo na kadodo la ɖeɖe ko.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ɖo eŋu be {status} na tɔtrɔwo ƒe ŋutinya, eya ta womete ŋu ta alɔ ƒe fli aɖeke o. Fork ƒe kadodo si le etame la de blibo.
